text: You! You've plagued our village for long enough. I'll kill you myself!

text: What do you want now?

text: Those damn Radscorpions have been after our Brahmin since we moved here. Not a week goes by that someone doesn't get poisoned trying to keep them out of the pens. Last week they took my brother Jarvis. Razlo, our doctor, is looking for an antidote as quickly as he can. Hey, if you have the means to help us, why don't you talk to our leader, Aradesh.
source_text:
Those damn Radscorpions have been after our Brahmin since we moved here.
 Not a week goes by that someone doesn't get poisoned trying to keep them out of the
 pens. Last week they took my brother Jarvis. Razlo, our doctor, is looking for an
 antidote as quickly as he can. Hey, if you have the means to help us, why don't
 you talk to our leader, Aradesh.

text: There are several groups of raiders. I organize guards like Ian to help fight them off. There is one band to the southeast of here. Watch out for them.
source_text:
There are several groups of raiders. I organize guards like Ian
 to help fight them off. There is one band to the southeast of here. Watch out for them.

text: Shady Sands is a peaceful community. We have our own irrigation system, so we can grow our own food. If we were not plagued with raiders and Radscorpions, we would have no problems.
